name: adhd
description: ADHD — a skill for coding agents. Tree-of-thought with pruning, built on the Claude & Codex Agent SDK. Fans out parallel divergent thoughts under different cognitive frames, scores, prunes traps, deepens the survivors. The no-brainer skill for creative and interdisciplinary work.
readmeExcerpt: # ADHD — a skill for agents [![CI](https://github.com/UditAkhourii/adhd/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/UditAkhourii/adhd/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/adhd-agent.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/adhd-agent) [![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](./LICENSE) [![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D18-brightgreen)](./documentation/install.md) [![Paper](https://img.shields.io/badge/paper-preprint-blueviolet)](https://adhdstack.github.io/) [![Featured: The New Stack](https://img.shields.io/badge/featured-The%20New%20Stack-ff5500)](https://thenewstack.io/claude-code-adhd/) [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-Join%20the%20chat-5865F2?logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/NbWwkwwGw) > ### 🎮 [**Join the ADHD Discord →**](https://discord.gg/NbWwkwwGw) > This is where the real-time thinking happens: frame design, eval problems, trap-hunting, and neurodivergence-inspired research on reasoning architectures. If you've got opinions on premature convergence, cognitive frames, or just want to argue about the next eval problem — **[come argue with us live](https://discord.gg/NbWwkwwGw).** > 👉 [**Join the ADHD community →**](https://tally.so/r/WO1Nzj) as a contributor, maintainer, early adopter, or just a member. One short form. We coordinate frame contributions, eval problems, integrations, and adopter onboarding there. > **An architectural fix for premature convergence in autoregressive reasoning.** Linear Chain-of-Thought anchors on whatever it says first. Tree-of-Thought widens the search but still walks a single shared context, so the anchoring persists across branches. **ADHD treats this as an architectural problem, not a prompting one** — it spawns N isolated reasoning processes under deliberately distorted cognitive frames, with zero shared context during divergence, then runs a separate critic pass to score, cluster, prune traps, and deepen the survivors. Reach for it on **design decisions, fuzzy debugging, naming, API surface design, strategy, and any prompt of the shape *"give me a few ways to…"***. 📄 **Preprint:** [ADHD: Parallel Divergent Ideation for Coding Agents](https://adhdstack.github.io/) · 👤 **Author:** Udit Akhouri — [@akhouriudit](https://x.com/akhouriudit) · [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/udit-akhouri-10160a168/) --- ## Side-by-side: baseline vs ADHD One eval problem, same model, two strategies. analysis.oneLine: adhd 是一个面向 AI 编程工作流的规则与提示词资产，适合用于提升 Claude Code 或同类编码 Agent 的执行稳定性。
analysis.problem: AI 编程工具容易在上下文、测试、回滚和任务边界上犯重复错误，需要可复用的工程约束
analysis.audience: 使用 AI 编程的开发者、技术负责人、希望建立团队级 AI 编码规范的小团队
detailParagraphs: adhd 更准确地说是一个面向 AI 编程工作流的规则与提示词资产，而不是一个只因为短期热度上榜的仓库。对国内用户来说，判断重点不应停留在 README 的自我描述，而要看它是否能解决一个真实、可复用、可持续维护的工作流问题：AI 编程工具容易在上下文、测试、回滚和任务边界上犯重复错误，需要可复用的工程约束。
如果把它放进实际使用场景，adhd 的价值主要来自提升 Claude Code 或同类编码 Agent 的执行稳定性。当前 Star 约 2,566，说明它已经具备一定社区关注度，但商业用户更需要继续验证三件事：是否能嵌入现有业务流程，是否能由团队基于 TypeScript 技术栈持续维护，以及是否能形成稳定交付而不是一次性 Demo。
从商业化和私有化角度看，它更像知识资产而非软件系统，价值在于能否转化为团队开发规范、评审清单或定制化 Agent 工作流。无需复杂部署，但需要根据团队技术栈、代码规范和安全要求改写后才能稳定使用。当前最需要警惕的是：风险在于规则泛化过度，直接复制可能不适合本地项目；需要结合真实仓库测试迭代。因此建议先用一个小范围真实任务做部署测试，再决定它适合作为内部工具、客户方案组件，还是仅作为趋势观察样本。
scenarios: 团队 AI 编码规范
analysis.interpretation: adhd 的评估重点是产品形态、工程成熟度和场景适配，而不是 README 文案本身。对付费信息服务用户来说，它的价值在于帮助快速判断是否值得投入一次部署验证、是否有二次开发空间、是否能成为降本增效工具或商业服务组件。
analysis.installRequirements: 通常需要 TypeScript 相关运行环境，具体版本以官方 README 为准。
analysis.installGuide:
npm install -g adhd-agent     # CLI
npm install adhd-agent        # library

analysis.commercialValue: 它更像知识资产而非软件系统，价值在于能否转化为团队开发规范、评审清单或定制化 Agent 工作流；当前更适合作为早期趋势观察对象，商业复用前要确认真实需求和维护质量。
analysis.efficiencyValue: 如果项目与现有工作流匹配，效率价值主要体现在提升 Claude Code 或同类编码 Agent 的执行稳定性，并减少从零选型和重复开发的时间。
analysis.learningValue: 适合学习以 TypeScript 为主的技术栈下同类项目的产品组织、工程结构、README 表达和社区反馈。
